rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an official government representative in diplomacy.

example.english: That diplomat will go to Beijing for a meeting next month.
example.traditional: 嗰位外交官下個月會去北京開會。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ngoi6 gaau1 gun1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 bak1 ging1 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for a person who is socially tactful and knows how to deal with others.

example.english: They’re really a diplomat, always mindful of other people’s feelings.
example.traditional: 佢真係識做人嘅人，成日都顧住人哋感受。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 sik1 zou6 jan4 ge3 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 gu3 zyu6 jan4 dei6 gam2 sau6
